flows.name: Validate the production route manifest
steps: Verify every exclusion exists and is unique
Confirm the estimated generated-route budget is below its guardrail
flows.expectedOutcome: The route manifest passes with sufficient headroom for Vercel's hard limit

flows.name: Preserve PM user workflows
steps: Limit new exclusions to internal diagnostic, feedback, and marketing APIs
Confirm no project or financial route appears in the exclusion diff
Verify the live PM route after deployment
flows.expectedOutcome: Project users retain commitments and billing access

claims.description: The production route source count is below the repository guardrail
No PM project or financial route is excluded
